title: Angel Hub -
features:
Angel Hub — Anime Breaker

Angel Hub is an automation script for Anime Breaker focused on farming, game modes, gachas, equipment and progression with minimal manual setup.

Main Features

* Auto Farm with enemy and world priority
* Automatic target detection
* Smart positioning and teleporting
* Automatic recovery when farming stops dealing damage

Auto Trial

* Automatically enters Time Trial
* Farms enemies automatically
* Custom Leave at Wave
* Automatically leaves when finished

Auto Portal

* Automatically opens selected Portals
* Multiple Portal ranks
* Highest First / Lowest First
* Automatically farms the required Raid when necessary
* Custom Quit In timer

Auto Raid

* Select Raid map
* Automatically enters and starts Raids
* Automatic enemy farming
* Custom Leave at Wave
* Automatic ticket farming

Priority System

Trial • Portal • Raid • Farm

Set the order you want and the script automatically switches between enabled modes based on your priority.

Potions

* Automatic potion usage
* Separate settings for Trial, Farm, Raid and Portal
* Custom potion selection for each mode
* T2 → T1 priority

Equipment

* Auto Equip Best Multipliers
* Separate profiles for World, Trial, Raid and Portal
* Energy
* Damage
* Gold
* Drop
* Gacha Luck
* Card Luck
* Auto Equip Best Weapon
* Auto Equip Best Accessory
* Auto Equip Best Pets
* Auto Merge Weapons

Gachas

* Auto Gacha
* Gacha Priority List
* Auto Pet Gacha
* Pet Gacha selection
* Always / After Gachas modes
* Fast automatic spinning

Misc

* Anti-AFK
* Streamer Mode
* Custom Walk Speed
* Infinity Jump
* Custom Jump Height

Interface

* Angel Hub interface
* Player and session information
* FPS and Ping display
* Activity status
* Persistent settings
* Automatic config saving
* Dark, Cobalt, Amethyst and Sakura Bloom themes
* Resizable interface
* Hide My Identity support
